name: Barpeta Cubing Open 2026
information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk0NTY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2155f491d9e53d28337fff6ba49c30cb399c166/Speed%20cubing%20barpeta%20open%202026.png)

* **Participants must bring their own puzzles.**
* Make sure to be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate.
* Attend the new participants tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules.
* Bring a Government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition.
* Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.
